# Placeholderworks

> Placeholderworks (https://placeholderworks.com) is an AI engineering and implementation company based in India, working with clients in every country. We build AI that makes it to production: we design, build, integrate and deploy AI systems that do real work, rather than only advising on them. If a piece of work can be automated, we build the system that does it.

## What we build, by modality

### Voice
- Real-time calling agents for any use case, inbound and outbound, integrated with the client's own telephony.
- Live customer support on the phone, with live transfer of the call to a person on the client's team when needed.
- Voice bots that take action: voice chatbots that carry out what the caller asks, in any domain.
- Voice Agent Dashboard: live analytics for voice agents and configuration of new use cases, such as abandoned cart calling.

### WhatsApp and web
- Real-time WhatsApp chatbots, configurable for any use case.
- CRM and ERP automation via WhatsApp: read and update CRM and ERP records from a WhatsApp chat.
- Website bots and agents that take over work done by hand.
- Real-time chatbots connected to a company's customer care services.

### Email and workforce
- Email automation.
- Automatic email classifiers that sort and route incoming email.
- Internal workforce automation: agents that replace manual dependency in repetitive internal work.

### Video
- EasyShorts as a service: any YouTube video turned into any number of shorts, chosen on research into what goes viral, edited automatically, with captions and background music, and published to YouTube automatically.

### Apps
- Apps inside ChatGPT: publishing a client's product as an app (plugin) in ChatGPT, as built for Adam Vacations.
- AI native apps, built with AI integrated from the start. Example: Kasolit, a Blinkit-style app for reaching local customers.

### Evals and QA
- Eval engines for any modality (voice, chat, image, text) that show which model outperforms where and which fits a given use case.
- QA automation engines that automate software QA testing.

## What we build, by domain

- Real estate and rentals: WhatsApp chatbots for real-time flat hunting; rent data products such as RentaLease.
- Travel and hospitality: travel apps inside ChatGPT, as built for Adam Vacations; calling agents for booking questions.
- E-commerce and retail: abandoned cart calling; order updates and support on WhatsApp.
- Local commerce: AI native apps connecting local sellers with nearby customers, such as Kasolit.
- Customer support: calling agents with live call transfer; chatbots that hand off to the team.
- Media and creators: shorts made from long videos and published automatically.
- Education: enquiry lines on voice and WhatsApp for students and parents.
- Sales and operations: email classifiers, CRM and ERP updates from WhatsApp, workforce automation.
- Product and engineering: model evals, QA automation engines, apps inside ChatGPT.

## Products

- WhatsApp Chatbot: a real-time WhatsApp chatbot for any use case, connecting to CRM, ERP and customer care. One deployment is real-time flat hunting in metro cities, powering RentaLease.
- [RentaLease](https://rentalease.in): the real rent map of Delhi NCR, live in Gurgaon. Tenants drop anonymous pins with the rent they actually pay. Zero brokerage, no signup, free for tenants, with flatmate, room and PG pins, rent trends by area and BHK, and a commute view.
- EasyShorts: turns any YouTube video into viral-ready shorts, chosen on research, with automatic editing, captions, background music and automatic publishing to YouTube. Available as a product and as a service.
- Voice Agent Dashboard: live analytics for voice agents, and configuration for any use case, such as abandoned cart calling.
- Eval Labs: evals across voice, chat, image and text to see which model outperforms where and fits a use case.
- More products are on their way.

## Client work

- Adam Vacations (travel: flights): their app inside ChatGPT, built and published as a ChatGPT app (plugin) so travellers can use Adam Vacations from the conversation. https://www.adamvacations.com
- RentaLease (real estate, Delhi NCR): a zero-brokerage rent map built on anonymous tenant pins, with flatmate, room and PG pins, rent trends, a commute view, alerts, and a real-time WhatsApp chatbot for flat hunting. Live in Gurgaon. https://rentalease.in

## How we work

From the problem to a system running in production: discovery, design, build, integration, production, and iteration. One team owns the whole path, with no handoff between the people who advise and the people who build.
